visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all59 final frames:13 portable,13 shared and33 medium-fi. Whole-parcel turntables and dedicated whole-level views retain the western U-shaped open light court, Broadway offset tower, two setbacks, eight tourelles and241.4016m finial. Current-owner reference showed the original uninterrupted roof cone omitted the upper window lantern and dormers; the reviewed source has a large copper pyramid, dormers, octagonal window lantern, smaller roof and spire. Final western court view shows sloping green copper roofs and projecting dormers. Entry cameras show the cut Tudor portal and three-bay transom with side doors and glazed revolving enclosure. Initial door panes faced inward; final winding correction makes them visible with shared single-sided materials. Initial lower roof was too vertical; final mansard slopes inward, its finials are grounded on the roof crest. Dedicated whole cameras include every part; narrow facade/detail views deliberately crop the rest of the building.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Five reusable256px granite, limestone, ceramic, copper and bronze graphs replace the former all-granite wall/painted-metal roof approximation. Seven-foot granite water table and lower four-story limestone have distinct bindings; pale upper glazed terra cotta uses neutral shared ceramic coating, copper is low-metallic oxidized copper, doorway uses shared bronze. Generic tile seams and blue accent strips approximate polychromy without copying photographs. Glass and recesses use palette PBR. All six GLBs have zero embedded images. Source and near levels use seven material groups, district six, skyline one averaged group. Shared capture reads each graph once and disposes all model geometry on unload.

mediumFiReview.notes: Actually inspected noon/late economy/high views, texture-free skyline silhouette, source-detail cameras, eight dedicated LOD cameras and four transitions. Full U-shaped base and the stepped Gothic/copper skyline survive every level. Skyline omits individual window bays and dormers while retaining all eight corner roofs and upper lantern; district retains continuous dark window strips with horizontal spandrels and one reconstructed dormer row, drops tiny corner finials; street keeps individual window bays but omits tiny frame/sill sections; closeup uses flat frame and sill plates instead of detailed 3D sections. Synthetic brownstone neighbors are a style fixture rather than actual Manhattan surroundings. No missing parcel section or blocked west court was observed.

limitations: Whole medium-fi Woolworth parcel retains the U-shaped base, open western light court, Broadway tower, two setbacks, eight mapped corner tourelles and241.4016m published792ft height. Reviewed source corrects the false sharp entrance to a genuinely recessed depressed Tudor arch with three-bay transom, center revolving enclosure, side doors and balcony. Compound crown now has large green copper pyramid, dormers, octagonal window lantern, smaller pyramid and finial; lower western wings have shallow copper mansard/dormer ribbons. These shapes follow inspected primary city/owner/restoration images; individual roof and doorway dimensions are reconstructed, not a surveyed plan.
